items.explanation: Curious means wanting to know or learn — like asking many questions.

items.prompt: Which word means 'feeling happy about something you did'?
items.explanation: Proud means feeling happy about something you did, like neat handwriting.

options.text: The curious boy asked many questions.
Ana is proud of her neat handwriting.
The library is silent during reading time.
The tiny ant carried a big leaf.

items.explanation: Silent means very quiet, so it fits a library during reading time.

items.prompt: Which word fits in this sentence: 'Milo is ___ about the box in the corner.'
items.explanation: A box in the corner makes you wonder, so Milo feels curious about it.

items.prompt: Find the word that means 'very small'.
items.explanation: Tiny means very small — an ant is a tiny creature.
